articles.summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd. (the “Company”) hereby updates that on October 6, 2026, the first part (30 MW) of the 87 MW solar facility constructed by Ellomay Solar Italy Five S.r.l, an Italian private company 51% owned by the Company (the “Ellomay Solar Five Facility”), was successfully connected to the Italian national grid and commenced production […]
articles.title: Commencement of Connection to Grid of an 87 MW Solar Project in Italy
